data.narrative:
Galadyne is a Pre-Seed stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Chandler Luzsicza. The company has raised $4.8M to date. The comparable universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers spanning the Defense & Security sector, with notable private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Valuation was conducted using the Stage-Progression method, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. This method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage progression, using the $4.8M total raised as a proxy base value. This yields an implied valuation of $12M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable; while 24 Defense & Security peers exist in the dataset, filtering for same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers produced fewer than three datapoints, making a narrow peer median unreliable. A broad all-sector median would introduce unacceptable sector divergence.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects typical Pre-Seed progression mechanics but carries material uncertainty given the single-method foundation. Key risks include the absence of narrow-set peer validation and the stage-progression multiplier's sensitivity to market conditions and company-specific risk profile. Additional validation through revenue or user traction metrics—not available in this dataset—would narrow the range considerably.
